With interventions this week from Keir Starmer, Tony Blair, Andy Burnham and Wes Streeting, the battle for Labour's direction is underway. Duncan-Jordan discusses Socialism26, a proposal aimed at reshaping the party's priorities and reconnecting it with voters.

programme.title: Nicholas Galitzine & Camila Mendes Take On The British Test
programme.desc: Camila Mendes and Nicholas Galitzine from Masters of the Universe take on The British Test, tackling Britain's biggest cultural talking points. They attempt to make the perfect cup of tea, give their honest verdict on British food, debate whether Idris Elba should be the next James Bond, discuss their favourite British TV shows, and try Colin the Caterpillar cake.

programme.title: Ireland legend Louise Quinn Interview
programme.desc: Louise Quinn is a former professional footballer who played on the Irish squad for 17 years, garnering 122 caps and 16 goals as a centre back for the girls in green. She reflects on some of her career highlights including training in freezing temperatures, lifting the cup with Arsenal and her final game in the Irish jersey.

programme.title: I Humiliated A GB News Host On Live TV
programme.desc: Andy debriefs his televised clash with Matt Goodwin over accusations that the Gorton and Denton by-election candidate used AI to research his book. Seán and Andy revisit the best moments of the debate, from Goodwin's evasive answers to his use of ChatGPT to defend himself.

programme.title: How The Taliban Really Works
programme.desc: Sean Langan is a British journalist and documentary filmmaker who has spent decades reporting from some of the world's most dangerous conflict zones, including Afghanistan, Iraq and Russia. He spent years covering the Taliban in his documentaries Fighting the Taliban, Meeting the Taliban and Afghan Ladies' Driving School.

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists
programme.desc: Matt Kennard discusses his book Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members and Criminals. Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

programme.title: Holocaust Survivor Eviscerates The Far-Right
programme.desc: Stephen Kapos is an 88-year-old Holocaust survivor who discusses his activism, his opposition to Israel's systemic destruction of Gaza and the West Bank, and how the memory of the Holocaust is being abused by Israel and the far-right.

programme.title: Ed Sheeran's Palestine Downfall
programme.desc: Ed Sheeran dropped Macklemore from his tour over the artist's pro-Palestine platform. He played his last gig alone, after all of his supporting artists and his backing band dropped out in solidarity. Ava and Seán break down what happened and react to Sheeran's apology.

programme.title: Did A GB News Host Write A Book Full Of AI Slop?
programme.desc: Andy investigates Matthew Goodwin's new book and uncovers significant issues with its content. After Goodwin's defeat in the Gorton and Denton by-election, his release is examined closely, with Andy and Ava challenging a series of claims that don't hold up. From questionable statistics about English language use in schools to references that appear to trace back to ChatGPT, the pair expose what is at the very least a lack of academic rigour.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: In the southwest of Portugal lies the little known Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina. It encompasses a narrow coastal strip that runs along the coast to the south of Portugal. Sparsely populated, this coastal region, which was placed under protection in 1988, is considered one of the last intact ecosystems in Europe. The steep cliffs, the almost constant wind and high waves have ensured that mass tourism has not gained a foothold here. There are still near-natural forests and a diverse bird life.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: Madeira - Portugal's autonomous island in the Atlantic Ocean, is closer to the African coast than to the mother country Portugal, from which it is separated by about 900 kilometers. The island's name comes from Portuguese sailors who claimed the uninhabited isle for themselves in 1419. Madeira means wood and that was available in abundance. Almost the entire surface was covered by dense forest. Since 1982, two-thirds of the landscape has been protected.

programme.title: Portugal's Nature Parks
programme.desc: The "Parque Natural da Ria Formosa" is one of the largest lagoon conservation areas in Europe. Bordered by five natural islands. A mosaic of sandbanks, brackish and freshwater lagoons and salt marshes. In 2010, the "Ria Formosa" was chosen as one of the seven natural wonders of Portugal. It is a unique ecosystem: in the winter months, more than 20,000 birds gather here. In addition, the nature park has one of the largest seahorse populations internationally. More than half of all fish species in the Atlantic are said to spawn in the lagoon.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest

programme.title: From the Alps to Tuscany
programme.desc: Winter in north Italy: ice and snow rule over the Dolomites for months on end – only specialists can live up here in the high mountains: like the Ibex, for example. Hardly any other animal can climb so efficiently and scale the steepest slopes so elegantly. Even Ibex, however, descend to lower regions when the ice and snow are lying – the risk of falling is simply too high in winter. When an animal does succumb to the conditions, the Golden Eagle takes advantage. The ‘King of the Skies' becomes a scavenger in winter, when he can't catch prey himself - and he has to share, whether he likes it or not, as ravens and crows are quick to the scene of death. As soon as spring arrives, huge amounts of melt water plummet down from the Dolomites into the valley, feeding streams and rivers across north Italy – including the Po. At the Adriatic coast, Italy's longest river joins the Mediterranean and forms a vast delta. In the 1980's, salt-works were in operation here today however the area is a paradise for birds. The protected delta magically attracts rare water birds like the Purple Heron, and even Greater Flamingos. He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This fairy tale is about one little and witty tailor, who had a chance to defeat the giant and obtain a fridge full of sweets. So he ate all of them at once. Then he decided to get out on the street, but could not, as he overate and got stuck in the door. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Who is the best cook in all the forest? Masha has no doubts as to how to correctly answer this question. And the proof is right before you: macaroni cooked by Masha herself. What can be simpler? Only Dasha is somehow sure that Masha's final product is inedible. As usual, Bear will have to solve the girls' dispute, as usual.

Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: Bright summer day. Bear, while gathering berries, meets female bear in the forest and arranges a date with her. Returning home, he starts cleaning the house and baking a pie. Once the pie is done, the Bear decorates it with strawberries. Masha eats them before starting to hiccup. The Bear tries all manner of remedies from a medical encyclo-pedia to stop the hiccups. In the end, hiccups spread to everyone including all other forest in-habitants.

programme.title: Deadly Spores
programme.desc: Canadian doctors are alarmed when a middle-aged woman dies of cryptococcal meningitis in 1999. Over the next few years, doctors see dozens of similar infections with pneumonia-like symptoms including shortness of breath, weight loss and severe headaches. Vancouver Island becomes home to the largest outbreak of the deadly fungus anywhere in the world. Local veterinarians report dozens of cases in the animal population, raising fears that the reach of the deadly fungus is not limited to any one species. DNA typing reveals that this new form of cryptococcus is identical to a strain normally found in Australia, leaving doctors with more questions than answers.

programme.title: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial- Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder. The jury heard hundreds of hours of testimony and every twist and turn of the trial was played out in the media, but what was the evidence? Forensic scientists reconstructed the events that took place on the night Nicole Brown Simpson was murdered. But was their report accurate, and could the evidence be trusted? We'll examine what forensics could and could not tell us about the trial of the century.

programme.title: Dangerous Contact

A fellow researcher confides that he has recently been plagued by bizarre medical problems including memory loss, confusion, numbness and a burning sensation on the skin, symptoms identical to Burkholder's. programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: TYOHAAR KI THAALI
programme.desc: Sakshi Tanwar in Tyohaar Ki Thaali decides to celebrate one festival a week and along with the celebration, she also prepares two dishes from her mom's diary which is her prized possession. Along with preparing the dishes she also reminisces into the moments of how she celebrated some festivals and also shares some stories about the Gods.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: UMEED INDIA
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer's festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Panarea
programme.desc: Divertenti storie intrecciate in un fine settimana estivo a Panarea, la più piccola delle isole Eolie: Enrico cerca di sedurre la bella Maria ma è costantemente intralciato dalla sorellina Claudia, i due amici Riccardo e Luca scommettono su chi dei due farà colpo su Alessandra, un ragazzo rimasto da solo organizza una festa nella villa dei genitori.

programme.title: La spiaggia dei gabbiani
programme.desc: Brillante commedia on the road. Un gruppo di amici, ex compagni di scuola, parte per un viaggio in barca a vela alla ricerca di libertà e leggerezza. La vacanza prende però una piega inaspettata quando emergono dinamiche del passato e tensioni accumulate nel corso degli anni e un misterioso intruso si unisce al loro viaggio, svelando verità nascoste.

programme.title: Italian boys
programme.desc: Una sfida fino all'ultima nota musicale in questa commedia cult anni 80 con la regia di Umberto Smaila. Trip Radio e Radio Metropolis, due emittenti separate da un'accesa rivalità, sono impegnate in una gara musicale: vincerà chi saprà conquistare il pubblico femminile. I risultati sono incerti, ma entrambe cercheranno di assicurarsi l'appoggio di cantanti come Ivan Graziani e Andrea Mingardi.

programme.title: La banda del Buffardello e il manoscritto di Leonardo da Vinci
programme.desc: Questa è la storia di Aldebrando Testori (Umberto Smaila), un editore fallito che trovandosi sul lastrico avrà un'idea geniale: mettere in piedi una banda di falsari per creare un finto manoscritto di Leonardo da Vinci e partecipare a un'asta spacciandolo per autentico.

programme.title: La banda degli onesti
programme.desc: Esilarante commedia diretta da Camillo Mastrocinque in cui l'inossidabile coppia Totò e Peppino si cimentano nella fabbricazione di banconote false con l'aiuto di un pittore.

programme.title: Vogliamo i colonnelli
programme.desc: Presentato in concorso al Festival di Cannes, questo capolavoro di Monicelli è una brillante commedia satirica interpretata dal grande Ugo Tognazzi. Nell'Italia degli anni Settanta, un deputato di destra, Giuseppe Tritoni, spalleggiato da un gruppo di colonnelli, progetta un golpe. Il Ministro degli Interni, però, viene a conoscenza del piano e ne approfitta.

programme.title: Intrigo a Taormina
programme.desc: Gli ospiti di un milionario, a bordo del suo yacht, si trovano invischiati in complessi intrecci romantici.

programme.title: Le cameriere
programme.desc: Gabriella, cameriera per una famiglia romana, indossa un gioiello della signora per cui lavora ad una festa. Senza accorgersene viene derubata da un affascinante uomo di cui la ragazza non ricorda il nome. Dopo essere stata denunciata per furto, insieme alle sue amiche, darà la caccia al misterioso seduttore per dimostrare la sua innocenza.

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: C'era una volta
programme.desc: Napoli, XVII secolo. Il principe Rodrigo Ferrantte y Davalos, nobile spagnolo di grande fascino e coraggio, è in Italia. Deve trovare una sposa e la corte gli impone la scelta tra sette belle principesse. Ma lui s`innamora di una paesana, semplice, fiera e sanguigna, di rara bellezza e di incredibili virtù, di nome Isabella. Il loro amore, fulmineo e improvviso, incontrerà molti ostacoli...

programme.title: Cronaca di un amore
programme.desc: Enrico, vittima di una immotivata gelosia nei confronti del passato sentimentale della moglie Paola, assolda un investigatore per capire se gli fedele. Questo atteggiamento spinge Paola tra le braccia di Guido, uomo di cui era innamorata in passato. Inevitabilmente, tra i due scoppia una pericolosa e travolgente passione...

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Tre ragazze condividono un sogno: fare fortuna. Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: Un padre, una figlia
programme.desc: Romeo ha cresciuto con amore la figlia Eliza, sperando in un futuro brillante per lei all'estero. Quando Eliza vince una borsa di studio, la sua vita sembra finalmente prendere il volo. Ma l'aggressione che subisce il giorno prima dell'esame di ammissione in Regno Unito metterà a dura prova le sue scelte e i valori che ha sempre trasmesso alla figlia.

programme.title: The Old Man and The Gun
programme.desc: La storia vera della fuga dal carcere del settantenne Forrest Tucker, della successiva fuga dal detective Hunt e della sua storia d'amore.

programme.title: Ladre per caso
programme.desc: L'introversa Carole e la ribelle Caroline hanno in comune solo il padre Patrick, un ladro internazionale ricercato ovunque. Intenzionato a rubare uno «stradivari», Patrick chiederà aiuto alle due figlie, tentando di recuperare il tempo perduto.

programme.title: L'imperdibile viaggio di Harold Fry
programme.desc: Harold è un uomo qualunque che ha sempre vissuto senza prendere iniziative. Un giorno scopre che una vecchia amica è molto malata e decide di andarla a trovare attraversando a piedi l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: UN ANNO PER CAMBIARE
programme.desc: Dopo esser caduto da un tetto alla festa di Capodanno ed essere sopravvissuto, Owen decide che è il momento di cambiare vita. Obiettivi principali: innamorarsi e rientrare in contatto col figlio

programme.title: PICNIC A HANGING ROCK
programme.desc: Dal regista de L'attimo fuggente, The Truman Show, Master & Commander, un dramma avvolto nel mistero che si consuma nel primo San Valentino del '900. Le ragazze del collegio di Appleyard si recano in gita ad Hanging Rock, una suggestiva formazione rocciosa. Tre delle fanciulle scompaiono misteriosamente e a nulla valgono le ricerche. Cosa accadde quel giorno di S. Valentino è ancora un mistero…

programme.title: La casa del custode
programme.desc: Dopo l' omicidio della moglie e dei figli Jacob, compositore dilettante di Brooklyn, comincia a vagare senza meta, sperando di comprendere la tragedia che gli è occorsa. Per puro caso arriva a Brent, in Alabama. Qui viene accolto da Nina, madre single e cantante di un coro gospel. Grazie al potere della musica, Jacob comincerà a guardare nuovamente al futuro.

programme.title: LARS E UNA RAGAZZA TUTTA SUA
programme.desc: Lars è un uomo estremamente timido e isolato che sorprende tutti presentando una bambola come la propria fidanzata. La comunità sceglie di assecondarlo in un percorso inatteso di crescita e guarigione emotiva.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs e Octopus accettano un lavoro dal loro padrone di casa, in cambio di una lauta ricompensa: rapire un bambino. Ben presto, il bebè risveglia forti sentimenti paterni nei due truffatori, portando a complicazioni quando si tratta di riconsegnarlo.

programme.title: Chiedi Alla Polvere
programme.desc: Nella Los Angeles della Grande Depressione si incontrano lo scrittore italo-americano Arturo e la cameriera messicana Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere il romanzo della vita, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti.

programme.title: Another Happy Day
programme.desc: Alla vigilia del matrimonio di suo figlio, Lynn, una donna che ha sempre nascosto le sue emozioni, insieme ai suoi tre figli dovrà fare i conti con le montagne russe emotive di una riunione di famiglia. Una commedia oscura con Ellen Barkin e Demi Moore.

programme.title: A Circus Story and a Love Song
programme.desc: Refugio, un romantico sognatore la cui ricerca del vero amore, durata anni, lo porta dalla vita circense in Messico alla vita notturna di New Orleans, dove si innamora inaspettatamente di una bellissima ballerina esotica con un passato complicato.

programme.title: Dragged Across Concrete: Poliziotti al limite
programme.desc: C'è un poliziotto di lunga esperienza di nome Ridgeman e c'è il suo partner più giovane, più goloso e chiacchierone: Anthony. Durante l'arresto di uno spacciatore latinoamericano, i due ci vanno giù poco leggeri e vengono ripresi dalla videocamera di un vicino indignato e sbattuti al telegiornale.

programme.title: La Famiglia Fang
programme.desc: Caleb e Camille Fang sono performer le cui creazioni scioccano il pubblico e deliziano gli appassionati d'arte. Protagonisti sin dalla più tenera età sono i loro figli, pedine fondamentali delle loro opere provocatorie spesso al limite tra il genio e la follia.

programme.title: Miss Julie
programme.desc: Una residenza di campagna in Irlanda intorno al 1880. Nel corso di una notte di mezza estate, in un clima di baldoria selvaggia e vincoli sociali allentati, la giovane Julie e John, cameriere di suo padre, ballano e bevono, si corteggiano e manipolano.

programme.title: Suocero scatenato
programme.desc: Un padre, maniaco del lavoro, spera di poter incontrare la figlia durante una sosta a Los Angeles. Scopre però che la ragazza è scomparsa e si ritrova costretto a collaborare con la sua ex goffa fidanzata per ritrovarla. Vivrà così una notte che cambierà per sempre la sua esistenza.

programme.title: Il silenzio del testimone
programme.desc: Un importante avvocato difensore torna nella sua piccola città natale per difendere un vecchio amico accusato di omicidio.

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

programme.title: Il silenzio del testimone
programme.desc: Un importante avvocato difensore torna nella sua piccola città natale per difendere un vecchio amico accusato di omicidio.

programme.title: Un Ragionevole Dubbio
programme.desc: Mitch, un brillante procuratore, investe accidentalmente un passante, scappando senza prestargli soccorso. Dopo aver scoperto che un uomo è stato arrestato al suo posto, i sensi di colpa spingeranno Mitch a far cadere le accuse. E se Mitch si fosse sbagliato? Se quell'uomo non fosse innocente?

programme.title: 10 cose da fare prima di lasciarsi
programme.desc: Dopo che Abigail, una mamma single con due figli, rimane incinta dopo un'avventura di una notte con Ben, l'improbabile coppia cerca in tutti i modi di restare insieme. Una divertente commedia romantica con protagonista Christina Ricci.

programme.title: Anime gemelle
programme.desc: A seguito di un violento incidente d'auto, Michael si risveglia in una stanza, al cospetto di una misteriosa donna (Christina Ricci) che gli rivela che è morto e che per accedere al mondo ultraterreno dovrà completare la sua missione sulla Terra, trovare l'anima gemella. Ma trovare l'amore vero in una città caotica come New York non è certo una missione facile, tanto più se si è morti.

programme.title: Double Whammy
programme.desc: Un detective di polizia disilluso, che non riesce a impedire una strage in un fast food, lotta per riconquistare la reputazione all'interno del dipartimento, l'immagine pubblica e la propria autostima.

programme.title: Che fine ha fatto Harold Smith?
programme.desc: Inghilterra, anni Settanta. La vita del diciottenne Vince Smith e del padre Harold cambia radicalmente quando il giovane si innamora della vivace Joanna, mentre Harold scopre di avere un inaspettato talento per i poteri soprannaturali. Questo lo renderà una celebrità fino a quando un incidente non lo porterà sotto processo, sconvolgendo per sempre la vita dell'intera famiglia.

programme.title: La fragranza del cuore
programme.desc: Dopo essersi formata come profumiera a Parigi, Rosalie torna nella sua piccola città natale. Decide di aprire un negozio per vendere il suo profumo e l'unico spazio disponibile è di proprietà del precedentemente nerd, ora affascinante Ryan.

programme.title: Un legame fatale
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente d'auto che lascia il suo fidanzato Patrick in coma, la graphic designer April inizia a soffrire di attacchi di panico. Ma il suo nuovo amico nasconde forse un secondo fine?

programme.title: A Bride's Nightmare
programme.desc: Quando il giorno del proprio matrimonio Leah viene rapita da Kayla, l'ex fidanzata delirante del suo futuro sposo, farà di tutto per fuggire. Ma una volta riuscita nell'intento, Leah comincia a chiedersi se Kayla sia veramente delirante o se sta solo cercando di salvarle la vita.

programme.title: La madre sbagliata
programme.desc: Il sogno di Kaylene Larsen si è finalmente avverato: due bellissimi gemelli nati da una fecondazione in vitro. Ma quando Kelsey ha bisogno di assistenza domiciliare, l'infermiera che assume non è altro che lastessa donatrice di ovuli - e la pazza è venuta a reclamare i suoi bambini!

programme.title: Chiedi alla polvere
programme.desc: A Los Angeles della Grande Depressione si incontrano lo scrittore Arturo e la cameriera Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere un romanzo, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti. Diversi per estrazione etnica e culturale, finiranno per innamorarsi in maniera del tutto inaspettata.

programme.title: Love on Harbor island
programme.desc: Lily è una giovane interior designer che abita a Seattle, ma è nata e cresciuta in un piccolo paese, dove sua zia Maggie gestisce un b&b. Avendo bisogno d'aiuto, Maggie chiama la nipote per aiutarla a gestire l'azienda. Lì incontra l'affascinante Marcus.

programme.title: Breath
programme.desc: Una giovane madre in crisi coniugale s'innamora di un detenuto condannato a morte. Riesce ad incontrarlo nel parlatorio, sconvolgendo i suoi sentimenti e suscitando reazioni nei suoi compagni di cella. Intanto scorrono le stagioni fino a che il marito di lei li scopre e cerca di separarli.

programme.title: Febbre a 90°
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar Colin Firth è Paul Ashworth, un insegnante di letteratura con l'amore per il calcio. Accanito tifoso dell'Arsenal ed emotivamente legato agli esiti di ogni singola partita, rischierà di mettere in crisi la sua relazione con la professoressa di storia, Sarah Hughes.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Quando Theresa porta il fidanzato Simon Green a casa per il 25° anniversario di matrimonoi dei genitori, dimentica di menzionare un piccolo dettaglio, è bianco. Deciso a rompere il fidanzamento di sua figlia, Percy Jones ci dimostra che i padri non sono sempre saggi.

programme.title: November Criminals
programme.desc: Il liceale Addison Schacht vende droga ai suoi compagni di classe, ha un rapporto turbolento con la sua migliore amica, e si improvvisa investigatore sfidando le autorità per scoprire la verità.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone è il numero uno dei controllori del traffico aereo, finché un tranquillo sconosciuto, Russell Bell, non viene trasferito nel dipartimento. La rivalità tra i due migliori controllori del traffico aereo del TRACON di New York sale a un livello potenzialmente pericoloso.

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: Mary, figlia di un'antesignana del femminismo e di un filosofo, cresce in bellezza e cultura. Appassionata di letteratura gotica e di fantasmi, si rifugia spesso in un cimitero e sogna di scrivere un giorno il suo romanzo.

programme.title: Futura
programme.desc: Louis è un jazzista di talento che ha ormai dimenticato i suoi sogni e vive a distanza le relazioni umane.

programme.title: Once Upon a Wedding
programme.desc: Una settimana prima del suo matrimonio, una donna ferisce un uomo in un incidente stradale. Mentre si prende cura di lui, inizia a dubitare di aver fatto le scelte giuste nella vita.

programme.title: Il disegno del Natale
programme.desc: Ember Morley, graphic designer e aspirante illustratrice di libri di fiabe a Manhattan, rimane sorpresa quando scopre di aver ereditato la fattoria degli alberi di Natale di sua nonna. Ritorna nella sua città natale, Willow Hill, per venderlo prima di Natale, ma gli affascinanti cittadini la convincono a restare un po' più a lungo e ad aiutarla a pianificare il loro annuale Festival dell'albero di Natale. Quando è costretta a lavorare con Brandon Hart, il bel custode della fattoria, Ember si ricorda delle cose che una volta desiderava nella vita. La magia del Natale la guiderà sulla strada giusta?

programme.title: Un amore da ricordare
programme.desc: Tenley trova finalmente il coraggio di incontrare dal vivo Jared, conosciuto online un anno prima. Quando questi ha un incidente, l'ospedale fa firmare i documenti a Tenley, facendo credere alla famiglia di Jared che i due siano sposati.

programme.title: Puoi baciare la damigella
programme.desc: Scarlett è un'influencer affermata di New York con una passione per la pasticceria. La ragazza, però, dovrà lasciare per breve tempo il suo nuovo impiego per prendere parte al matrimonio di sua sorella.

programme.title: La miliardaria
programme.desc: Epifania ha ereditato da suo padre una fortuna favolosa e un consiglio sul tipo di uomo da sposare. Lei, invece, si sposa senza seguire il consiglio di suo padre, ma il matrimonio si rivela un fallimento.

programme.title: Chiamatemi Helen Chiamatemi Helen
programme.desc: Un celebre chef affronta il percorso di transizione della figlia, nata maschio.

programme.title: Il ritmo dell'amore Il ritmo dell'amore
programme.desc: Frank è ossessionato dall'idea di ottenere una seconda stella per il suo ristorante.

programme.title: Passioni dal passato Passioni dal passato
programme.desc: Vent'anni fa Anne lasciò Tom e sposò suo fratello Kai. I tre si incontrano di nuovo in Malesia.

programme.title: In viaggio con Elsa In viaggio con Elsa
programme.desc: Quando il marito di Elsa muore, le lascia una villa in Croazia. Quando arriva, scopre un rudere da restaurare.

programme.title: SWOP
programme.desc: Dopo aver fatto l'amore insieme per la prima volta durante una selvaggia notte al college, Lainey e Jake si separano. I loro cammini si incrociano nuovamente anni dopo ed entrambi si rendono conto che quella debosciata serata ha avuto effetti drastici sulle rispettive vite sessuali: mentre Jake è divenuto un donnaiolo, Lainey è sempre bloccata con la persona sbagliata. Nonostante si sforzino di tenere a freno il desiderio che hanno l'uno per l'altra, Lainey e Jake realizzano presto che la loro esplosiva intesa potrebbe essere la risposta a tutti i loro problemi se solo potessero smettere di dormire con altra gente.

programme.title: Love n' Dancing
programme.desc: Siamo nel 2002: Jake Mitchell è un campione di danza swing che vince insieme a Corinne, sua partner nella vita e nella danza, il campionato mondiale. Jake è un ballerino particolare: è sordo per via di un'infezione all'orecchio da quando era adolescente, ma, nonostante questo, ha imparato a sentire le vibrazioni della musica in un modo tutto suo e ha iniziato a ballare. Oggi Jack è diventato un insegnante di ballo in giro per il mondo. Jessica Donovan è una insegnante di inglese, che ha abbondanato il sogno di ballare a Broadway per un lavoro più sicuro. Ha una relazione con Kent, ma tra i due le cose non vanno. Quando Jack e Jessica si incontrano è subito scintilla, non solo nella vita ma anche sul palco: i due, infatti, provano a competere per il nuovo campionato del mondo. Riusciranno a trionfare come coppia di ballo e non solo?

programme.title: Two Lovers
programme.desc: New York. Leonard non sa se seguire il proprio destino e sposare Sandra, la donna che i suoi genitori hanno scelto per lui, o ribellarsi e ascoltare i sentimenti che prova per la sua nuova vicina di casa, la bella e volubile Michelle, di cui si è perdutamente innamorato. Combattuto tra ragione e istinto, dovrà compiere la scelta più difficile…

programme.title: Me Without You
programme.desc: Londra, primi anni Settanta. Nell'assolato pomeriggio estivo di un bel quartiere residenziale, Holly e Marina si giurano amicizia eterna. Sono solo due bambine, ma sapranno tenere fede alla promessa fatta per anni, attraversando tre decenni e complicate vicissitudini familiari e sentimentali. ..

programme.title: Lola + Jeremy
programme.desc: Jeremy, 27 anni, è un graphic designer e con il suo amico Mathias gestisce l'agenzia Cercasi alibi disperatamente per creare finti alibi tramite fatture, ricevute e scontrini per i fidanzati fedifraghi. Lola, 25 anni, lavora in una fumetteria ed è appassionata di supereroi e dei film di Michel Gondry, in particolare di “Se mi lasci ti cancello” che non si stanca mai di rivedere. Lola e Jeremy decidono di riprendere ogni momento della loro storia d'amore, per creare una sorta di video diario giornaliero da riguardare da lì a dieci anni. Lola, troppo curiosa, non resiste e si mette a guardarli subito da sola. Video dopo video, ne trova uno che non avrebbe dovuto vedere: Jeremy e i suoi amici stanno parlando proprio di lei, prim'ancora di conoscersi, e del progetto di Jeremy di girare un video diario da mostrare al padre in fin di vita in ospedale. Lola, delusa e ferita lascia Jeremy il cui solo scopo sarà, da quel momento, cercare di riconquistarla. Disperato pensa di mettere insieme un gruppo di strampalati supereroi, che rapiscono personaggi famosi. Il riscatto? Lola. E così le vie della periferia parigina si animano di una scalcagnata banda di eroi da fumetto, impegnati a organizzare impossibili e grotteschi rapimenti. Nel film tre piccoli camei, quello del regista Michel Gondry nella parte di se stesso, il batterista Manu Katché, per anni al fianco di Peter Gabriel e il rapper Youssoupha.

programme.title: La Sorgente dell'Amore
programme.desc: Leila, giovane sposa magrebina, propone alle donne del suo villaggio di fare lo sciopero dell'amore: niente più sesso finché gli uomini non porteranno l'acqua al villaggio. E alla fine le donne la spunteranno.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: Ladre per caso
programme.desc: L'introversa Carole e la ribelle Caroline hanno in comune solo il padre Patrick, un ladro internazionale ricercato ovunque. Intenzionato a rubare uno «stradivari», Patrick chiederà aiuto alle due figlie, tentando di recuperare il tempo perduto.

programme.title: Un neomelodico presidente
programme.desc: Il cantante neomelodico Leopoldo Giappone, in arte Mimmo Dany, si candida a presidente della regione Campania con una lista a sé, l'UVC. Il suo sogno tuttavia resta quello di partecipare al reality show L'isola dei famosi, e per questo ha a che fare con la malavita.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: Il lanciatore della lega minore Gus Cantrell sta per essere mandato in pensione quando riceve l'opportunità di fare la prossima cosa migliore: gestire i South Carolina Buzz. La squadra di baseball in difficoltà è piena di giocatori terribili, ma il proprietario Roger Dorn conta su Cantrell per trasformarli in una franchigia di prima classe.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Nella cittadina di Nelson il capo dei pompieri C.D. Bales ha il complesso del naso troppo lungo. Si innamora della bella e intelligente astronoma Roxanne, ma questa è attratta da un altro, Chris, un pompiere anche lui arrivato da poco. Roxanne confida il segreto a C.D. che informa Chris questi, esterrefatto, chiede a C.D. di scrivere una lettera per Roxanne a suo nome. C.D. accetta e l'inganno continua finché Roxanne non si innamora dell'uomo che le ha scritto quelle lettere appassionate...

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Capo
programme.desc: Bloccato dalla neve in Pennsylvania, per il suo rituale servizio sul “giorno della marmotta”, il metereologo televisivo Phil Connors (Bill Murray) si ritrova fermo nel tempo, costretto a rivivere il 2 febbraio.

programme.title: La Squadra Più Scassata Della Lega
programme.desc: La nuova proprietaria dei Cleveland Indians forma una squadra orribile per poterla spostare.

programme.title: La pretora
programme.desc: Una pretora inflessibili affronta i ricatti dei rivali che usano la gemella pornostar, ma lei reagisce con fermezza

programme.title: Io tigro tu tigri egli tigra
programme.desc: Film a episodi con Renato Pozzetto, Cochi Ponzoni, Paolo Villaggio ed Enrico Montesano

programme.title: Furto di sera bel colpo si spera

programme.title: Travolto dagli affetti familiari

programme.title: Io vivo altrove!

programme.title: Ghost Academy
programme.desc: Un professore tormentato da allucinazioni di persone defunte, ottiene una cattedra per insegnare a una classe di soli cinque studenti. Ma gli alunni sono fantasmi, morti da più di vent'anni.

programme.desc: Il sedicenne Rick Stevens non desidera altro che conquistare il cuore di Nina Pennington, la ragazza dei suoi sogni ed è pronto a tutto pur di riuscirci. Si ritroverà, però, coinvolto in una serie di avvenimenti del tutto fuori dagli schemi.

programme.desc: Divertente, frizzante e imperdibile commedia western. Un famoso pistolero giunge gravemente ferito in uno sperduto paese canadese al confine con gli Stati Uniti d'America, Barclay's Brush.

programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Crazy In Love

Diecimila comparse, seicento cavalli, fedeli ricostruzioni storiche: l'incredibile vita di uno degli uomini più importanti della storia.
